description: This file defines the StateMachineStorageWriter struct, which provides methods to append entries of various data types to a log segment associated with a specific state machine ID, facilitating storage operations for state machine journaling.

classes.name: StateMachineStorageWriter
classes.description: A readonly struct that encapsulates methods to append various types of byte sequences to a log segment, tied to a specific state machine identifier.

methods.name: AppendEntry
methods.description: Appends a byte array or span-based value as an entry to the log segment, associating it with the state machine ID.

methods.name: AppendEntry
methods.description: Appends a ReadOnlySequence of bytes as an entry.

methods.name: AppendEntry
methods.description: Appends a generic value by writing it through a provided writer action.
